CHECKS ON ANTI-ROLL BAR

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check that there are no faults with the anti-roll bar

See Test 4420CA CHECKS ON REAR ANTI-ROLL BAR

More specifically:

- correct positioning of anti-roll bar in relation to the vehicle centre-line; of the bar is centered, check for any signs of mounting/bar sliding;

- paint not worn at the points where the bar and the crossmember come into contact;

- condition of centre flexible mountings in the contact area with the bar;

- presence of grease in the boots for the connecting rod between the bar and the longitudinal arm;

- fastenings to torque between bar and crossmember;

- fastenings to torque between bar and longitudinal arm connecting rod.

Check, after loosening the longitudinal arm, through a rotary movement, that there is no seizing/excessive clearance for both joints for the rod connecting the bar to the longitudinal arm.
